event_records.description: Rustam's escalated warranty claim is pending with the manufacturer's second-line team. No decision has been made yet.

rustam.name: Rustam
rustam.persona_brief:
You are Rustam.
Rustam has an escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine. He received an email yesterday stating that the manufacturer's second-line team would provide a decision within ten working days. He wants a decision within that timeframe.

manufacturer_s_second_line_team.name: Manufacturer's second-line team
manufacturer_s_second_line_team.persona_brief:
You are Manufacturer's second-line team.
The second-line team handles escalated warranty claims. They have received Rustam's claim and are aware of the ten-working-day quoted timeframe. They have not yet made a decision.

resolution.question: Will Rustam's escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine get a decision from the manufacturer's second-line team within the ten working days quoted in yesterday's email?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the manufacturer's second-line team actually communicated a decision on Rustam's warranty claim before the end of the ten working days (i.e., by 2026-08-17T23:59:59+05:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff (2026-08-19T18:00:00+05:00) if no decision has been communicated by then.
